scopeLimits: The ranked UN World Urbanization Prospects 2025 population-weighted locator is not a municipal boundary or parcel identity. pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: Official Moradabad district land-records page links the Uttar Pradesh land-record system; official state viewer and district map dashboard provide local revenue-map/record context. These sources confirm local land-record services, not point coverage.
technicalBlocker: The WUP locator is outside the verified extent for selected Kasba Moradabad, and the adjacent revenue-village identity is unresolved. The viewer identify response is not safely field-filterable and could expose personal/property information; no parcel identify call was made.
remainingUncertainty: Which revenue village or urban parcel service covers the WUP locator; whether an anonymous geometry-only endpoint is available for that exact area.
nextStep: Resolve the exact adjacent revenue village through official map selection or another safe public map; then use only a geometry and safe-ID endpoint if available.

viewerAndServiceTrace.summary: Anonymous viewer selectors resolved state 09, district Moradabad 135, tehsil 00719, village 220922 (कस्वा मुरादाबाद, hasData=true). Official getVVVVExtentGeoref for this selected village returned EPSG:32644 bounds x=282238.4922..285220.2884, y=3190220.2012..3193135.5627. The WUP point transformed to EPSG:32644 is approximately [281247.06,3191939.71], about 991 m west of that village extent. Control village 220927 (छावनी, hasData=false) returned a zero extent. This does not resolve neighboring-village coverage. Viewer getPlotAtXY returns an unfiltered interactive parcel info object with no safe allowlist; it was not called. WMS is raster rendering, not verified full-vector geometry.
